title: Turning down the Regent's herald's decree, and being told separately that Marrowgate had 'word you went under with the Companies,' both landed as flat +/-1 reputation ticks with no signal of how much weight they'd carry — only the final status recap made clear these were the two choices the whole epilogue hinged on ('You told the Regent's herald no, plain... Last Light heard you went under the mountain on the Free Companies' word, not the crown's').
